title: Menlo Ventures Backs FactoryAI After AI Coding Market Hits $30B
summary:
A new governed platform from FactoryAI handles the full software lifecycle from initial planning and review to security and documentation. Menlo Ventures is investing in the startup to expand the role of artificial intelligence beyond basic code generation into a model-agnostic system that manages the entire development loop.

The investment comes as the AI coding market grew from $550M to more than $30B in 2 years. Menlo's current AI portfolio includes lead positions in 5 of the top 15 consumer AI applications by monthly revenue and a Series D investment in Anthropic in January 2024 at a valuation of approximately $4B.

Menlo is investing in @FactoryAI  🚀

Proud to back Factory as they build the system that automates the entire software lifecycle: planning, review, testing, security, documentation, all of it.

Coding has gone from $550M to $30B+ in two years, but generation was only one piece. Factory closes the rest of the loop with a shared, governed, model-agnostic platform.

Excited to partner with @matanSF and @EnoReyes, and to witness their talent and vision firsthand.
